cards.title: Two reachable states
items: Both public constructors set Status = Placed directly — there is no create-as-draft path
Cancel(userId) is the only method that changes Status, and it only ever sets Cancelled
Update (ChangeAmount) and Get do not touch Status

cards.title: Draft is declared but unused
items: PurchaseOrderStatus also declares a Draft value
No constructor, handler or migration in this sample ever assigns it
Not drawn above: a state with no transition into it is not a lifecycle this sample exercises

cards.title: Cancelled is terminal
items: CancelPurchaseOrderCommandHandler refuses a second cancel with 409 Conflict (precondition.purchase-order-already-cancelled); it does not change Status again
No route moves an order back to Placed
Delete still works on a cancelled order — deletion is independent of status
